messages:
sam_ops: APAC (ap-southeast-1) cluster: sustained queue depth growth for mosaic-lite-8k and mistral-7b for ~45m. pod GPU mem pressure ~92%, avg GPU util 96%. admission control not dropping yet. marking for triage.

taylor_infra: can you paste the short grafana panel and which node pools?

lee_oncall: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/cluster/apac-queues -> link. quick dump:
```
NODE POOL: apac-gpu-pool-1
pod/mosaic-01 GPU% 97 mem% 91
pod/mosaic-02 GPU% 94 mem% 93
pod/mistral-01 GPU% 99 mem% 92
Pending pods: 8
queue_depth:mosaic-lite-8k  145 -> +60 in 15m
queue_depth:mistral-7b  98 -> +40 in 15m
```

ana_sre: typo: it's ana_sre :)

ana_sre: +1 on triage. initial thoughts: soft-throttle per-model, spillover to eu-west-1 for non-SLO-critical customers, and enable prefix caching for high-reuse keys. suggest RPS cap: mosaic-lite-8k -> 70rps, mistral-7b -> 40rps.

sam_ops: sounds good. any infra commands to run now?

taylor_infra: quick actions:
1) enable per-model admission:
```
rhctl admission set-rate --region ap-southeast-1 --model mosaic-lite-8k --rps 70
rhctl admission set-rate --region ap-southeast-1 --model mistral-7b --rps 40
```
2) enable spillover rule to eu-west-1 for customer tier "standard"
```
rhctl routing add-spillover --from ap-southeast-1 --to eu-west-1 --model mosaic-lite-8k --pct 25
```

capacity-bot: AVAILABLE_CAPACITY: {"spare_nodes": "2", "warm_pool": "0", "estimated_add_time_min": "18"} (bot)

lee_oncall: launching one extra node pool (spot) would give ~3x pods in 12-18m but preempt risk. if we do spot -> only for non-SLA traffic.

sam_ops: cost note: spot add + egress for spillover -> watch $ impact. how much egress expected at 25% spill?

ana_sre: rough calc: current apac traffic 1200rpm; 25% spill ~300rpm to eu-west. avg tokens per resp ~40 -> ~12k tokens/min -> ~720k tokens/hr -> ~$0.8/hr extra egress in cloud transfer + model cost delta depending on variant. small vs outage.

lee_oncall: just applied the rhctl admission set-rate for both models. routing spillover added at 18:42 UTC.

capacity-bot: ACTION_RESULT: admission rates updated, spillover rule created, new nodepool creation queued (eta 14m).

sam_ops: seeing queue depth flattening: mosaic-lite-8k -> 110, mistral-7b -> 70. nice. leave soft-throttle for 1h, monitor. if queue_depth(mosaic) > 200 or pending pods > 12 escalate to infra-lead @taylor_infra.

ana_sre: also flagging eval-run for output-quality drift for spillage-routed traffic (we saw slight latency differences). starting a lightweight eval set now.

lee_oncall: noted. I'll keep watch on pending pods and GPU mem. re-open if anything spikes. :thumbsup:
